seoDescription: Can you identify common garage and workshop tools from photos? Test your tool knowledge with 40 visual questions about hammers, wrenches, saws, clamps, and shop gear.
pageTitle: Only 1/12 People Can Name These Garage Tools
summary: Name common garage and workshop tools from photo clues, from basic hand tools to tougher workshop staples.

homepage.title: Can You Name All Of These Garage Tools?
homepage.summary: Spot hammers, wrenches, saws, clamps, and tougher workshop tools from photo clues.

footer.topicText: This quiz is a photo-based trivia challenge about common garage tools, workshop gear, and familiar repair equipment.
footer.aboutText: This quiz is for entertainment and general tool-recognition trivia only. Tool names, designs, and common uses can vary by region, trade, and brand, so each photo is meant as a playful recognition clue rather than repair advice, training, or safety guidance.

landing.quickStartText: You may have seen these tools in a garage, workshop, or toolbox. Can you name them from the photos?

stageGroups.title: Garage Basics
stageGroups.encouragement: Good start. Next up are gripping tools, outdoor cutters, and precision helpers.

questions.prompt: Which striking tool has a claw for pulling nails?
questions.explanation: The "claw" end is used for pulling nails out of wood.

questions.prompt: Can you identify this tool used for tightening bolts?
questions.explanation: An adjustable wrench can fit different nut and bolt sizes.

questions.prompt: Which screwdriver has this cross-shaped tip?
questions.explanation: A Phillips head screwdriver has a cross-shaped tip that fits matching screws.

questions.prompt: What do you call this tool for measuring length?
questions.explanation: A tape measure has a flexible strip that extends and retracts for measuring distance.

questions.prompt: Which tool helps check whether a surface is level?
questions.explanation: The bubble in the vial shows whether a surface is level.

questions.prompt: What is this power tool used for making holes?
questions.explanation: Power drills can be used for both drilling holes and driving screws.

questions.prompt: Can you name these hand tools for gripping and cutting?
questions.explanation: Pliers are used for gripping, bending, or cutting, depending on the type.

questions.prompt: What is this hand-held cutting tool?
questions.explanation: A handsaw is a manual saw commonly used for cutting wood.

stageGroups.title: Grip, Cut, And Measure
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice work. Now the quiz moves into sharper workshop tools and repair staples.

questions.prompt: What is this tool used for smoothing wood?
questions.explanation: A hand plane shaves off thin layers of wood for a smooth finish.

questions.prompt: What do you call this heavy-duty striking tool?
questions.explanation: It’s used for demolition and driving stakes into the ground.

questions.prompt: What is this long bar tool used for prying things apart?
questions.explanation: A pry bar is a strong metal bar used to lever, lift, or pull materials apart.

questions.prompt: What is this tool for gripping nuts and bolts?
questions.explanation: Locking pliers hold their grip after they are clamped onto an object.

questions.prompt: What is this tool for cutting small branches?
questions.explanation: Pruning shears are used for trimming small branches and plant stems.

questions.prompt: Which measuring tool has sliding jaws for precise measurements?
questions.explanation: Calipers use sliding jaws to measure outside, inside, or depth dimensions precisely.

questions.prompt: What is this tool for stripping wire insulation?
questions.explanation: Wire strippers remove the outer insulation from electrical wire.

questions.prompt: What is this tool for fastening large staples?
questions.explanation: A staple gun drives staples into fabric, wood, or other thin materials.

stageGroups.title: Workshop Essentials
stageGroups.encouragement: You are through the middle shelf. The next round gets into squares, files, saws, and shop gear.

questions.prompt: Can you identify this tool for cutting curves in wood?
questions.explanation: The thin blade allows curved cuts in wood and similar materials.

questions.prompt: What is this sharpening stone called?
questions.explanation: A whetstone is an abrasive stone used to sharpen knife and tool blades.

questions.prompt: Which tool is commonly used for clearing a blocked drain?
questions.explanation: A plunger uses suction and pressure to help clear a blocked drain.

questions.prompt: What is this tool for smoothing large surfaces?
questions.explanation: A power sander smooths surfaces using fast abrasive motion.

questions.prompt: Can you identify this tool for tightening hex bolts?
questions.explanation: A hex key fits bolts and screws with hexagonal sockets.

questions.prompt: What is this portable tool used for holding pieces together?
questions.explanation: A clamp holds materials steady while they are joined, cut, glued, or fastened.

questions.prompt: What is this tool for carving or chipping wood?
questions.explanation: A chisel has a sharp edge for cutting or shaping wood, metal, or stone.

questions.prompt: Which tool is used for gripping large round pipes?
questions.explanation: The adjustable serrated jaws are designed to grip round pipes.

stageGroups.title: Workshop Repair Tools
stageGroups.encouragement: Strong toolbox energy. The final round brings heavier-duty garage tools and finishing tools.

questions.prompt: What is this tool for checking 90-degree angles?
questions.explanation: A try square helps check whether an angle is exactly 90 degrees.

questions.prompt: What is this small tool for pulling out nail heads?
questions.explanation: A cat's paw is shaped to dig under nail heads and lever them out.

questions.prompt: Can you name this tool for smoothing metal or wood?
questions.explanation: A file has rough teeth that remove small amounts of material.

questions.prompt: What is this lightweight eye protection called?
questions.explanation: Safety glasses protect the eyes from dust, chips, and flying debris.

questions.prompt: Which tool is used for turning sockets?
questions.explanation: A ratchet turns a socket in one direction while resetting in the other.

questions.prompt: What is this tool for cutting thin metal?
questions.explanation: A hacksaw has fine teeth for cutting metal, plastic, or other firm materials.

questions.prompt: Can you name this tool for cutting wood at an angle?
questions.explanation: A miter saw is used for accurate angled cuts in wood.

questions.prompt: What is this tool with stiff wire bristles called?
questions.explanation: A wire brush has stiff metal bristles that help remove loose paint, rust, or debris.

stageGroups.title: Heavy-Duty Tools
stageGroups.encouragement: Final round complete. Time to see how well you know the tool rack.

questions.prompt: Which tool snaps a long straight chalk mark across a surface?
questions.explanation: A chalk line is pulled tight and snapped to leave a long straight guide mark.

questions.prompt: What is this flat blade tool for spreading putty or filler?
questions.explanation: A putty knife has a flat blade used to spread filler, putty, or similar soft materials.

questions.prompt: What is this bench-mounted tool with jaws for holding workpieces?
questions.explanation: A bench vise clamps a workpiece firmly while it is being cut, filed, drilled, or shaped.

questions.prompt: What is this vacuum used for cleaning dust and debris?
questions.explanation: A shop vac is a heavy-duty vacuum used in garages and workshops.

questions.prompt: Which long-handled hand tool is used for cutting through bolts?
questions.explanation: Bolt cutters use long handles to apply strong cutting force to bolts, chains, or padlocks.

questions.prompt: What is this handle used for turning removable sockets?
questions.explanation: A socket wrench turns removable sockets that fit different nuts and bolts.

questions.prompt: Can you name this tool for pushing nails below the surface?
questions.explanation: A nail set pushes nail heads slightly below the surface.

questions.prompt: What is this retractable box-cutter style tool called?
questions.explanation: A utility knife has a retractable blade for general cutting tasks.
